english.title: Registered person contravene / fail to comply with req notify Commission of death / absence service user - MHA 83
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person registered with the Care Quality Commission carrying out a regulated activity, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE..), failed to give notice to the Commission without delay of the

(A)_[death]_
(B)_[absence]_

of a service user, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME OF PERSON..) who was detained under the Mental Health Act 1983 or another enactment having that effect
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 17 and 25 of the Care Quality Commission (Registration) Regulations 2009.
